CREATE VIEW [dye].[v_JobCombineOrder]

AS



SELECT

a.SheetSeries,

a.CheckNo,

a.OrderSheetNo,

c.CustomerID,

c.DetailCustName,

c.CustSelfNo,

c.ContractNo,

c.ProdID,

c.CustFabricName,

c.ColorNum,

c.ColorRemarks,

c.CustSelfNoDetail,

ISNULL(c.OrderQty,0)+ISNULL(c.OutQty,0) AS OrderQty,

a.LastQty,

a.CombineQty,

a.IsMasterOrder,

c.Remarks,

b.SheetNo AS JobSheetNo,

b.NewProdID,

IIF(c.LabelID NOT IN('QC02','QC01'),c.LabelID,IIF(c.SheetKind=2,'QC02','QC01'))AS LabelID,

b.PreRolls,

b.PreVatQty,

c.ColorID,

c.CustColorNum,

b.SheetDate,

ISNULL(b.PreRolls,0)Rolls,

ISNULL(b.PreVatQty,0)WeightQty,

c.CustJobNo,

b.Q12,

b.Q13,

b.PreField1,

b.FixedQty

FROM dye.JobCombineOrder a 

LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet b ON a.SheetSeries = b.SheetSeries

LEFT JOIN dye.vwOrderToJob c ON c.CheckNo = a.CheckNo

WHERE 1=1

AND JobSheetType='0'



UNION ALL

SELECT

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),b.SheetSeries) AS SheetSeries,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),IIF(JobSheetType='3',b.CheckNo,'A0001')) AS CheckNo,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),IIF(JobSheetType='3',b.OrderSheetNo,'A0001')) AS OrderSheetNo,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),IIF(JobSheetType='3',b.CustomerID,'074')) AS CustomerID,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),NULL) AS DetailCustName,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),'存仓') AS CustSelfNo,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),'存仓') AS ContractNo,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),b.ProdID) AS ProdID,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),b.CustSelfProduct) AS CustFabricName,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),b.ColorNum) AS ColorNum,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(500),NULL) AS ColorRemarks,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),NULL) AS CustSelfNoDetail,

CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),NULL) AS OrderQty,

CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),NULL) AS LastQty,

CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),b.SumAssignedWeightQty) AS CombineQty,

CONVERT(INT,NULL) AS IsMasterOrder,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(300),NULL) AS Remarks,

b.SheetNo AS JobSheetNo,

b.NewProdID,

IIF(JobSheetType IN ('1','2','3'),b.LabelID,'QC01') AS LabelID,

b.PreRolls,

b.PreVatQty,

b.ColorID,

b.CustColorNum,

b.SheetDate,

ISNULL(b.PreRolls,0)Rolls,

ISNULL(b.PreVatQty,0)WeightQty,

'' AS CustJobNo,

b.Q12,

b.Q13,

b.PreField1,

b.FixedQty

FROM  dye.JobSheet b

UNION ALL



SELECT

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),b.SheetSeries) AS SheetSeries,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),IIF(JobSheetType='3',b.CheckNo,'B0001')) AS CheckNo,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),IIF(JobSheetType='3',b.OrderSheetNo,'B0001')) AS OrderSheetNo,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),IIF(JobSheetType='3',b.CustomerID,'074')) AS CustomerID,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),NULL) AS DetailCustName,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),'编检') AS CustSelfNo,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),'编检') AS ContractNo,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),b.ProdID) AS ProdID,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),b.CustSelfProduct) AS CustFabricName,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),b.ColorNum) AS ColorNum,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(500),NULL) AS ColorRemarks,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),NULL) AS CustSelfNoDetail,

CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),NULL) AS OrderQty,

CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),NULL) AS LastQty,

CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),b.SumAssignedWeightQty) AS CombineQty,

CONVERT(INT,NULL) AS IsMasterOrder,

CONVERT(VARCHAR(300),NULL) AS Remarks,

b.SheetNo AS JobSheetNo,

b.NewProdID,

IIF(JobSheetType IN ('1','2','3'),b.LabelID,'QC01') AS LabelID,

b.PreRolls,

b.PreVatQty,

b.ColorID,

b.CustColorNum,

b.SheetDate,

ISNULL(b.PreRolls,0)Rolls,

ISNULL(b.PreVatQty,0)WeightQty,

'' AS CustJobNo,

b.Q12,

b.Q13,

b.PreField1,

b.FixedQty

FROM  dye.JobSheet b

WHERE 1=1

AND JobSheetType='0'



UNION ALL

SELECT

b.SheetSeries,

b.CheckNo,

b.OrderSheetNo,

c.CustomerID,

c.DetailCustName,

c.CustSelfNo,

c.ContractNo,

c.ProdID,

c.CustFabricName,

c.ColorNum,

c.ColorRemarks,

c.CustSelfNoDetail,

ISNULL(c.OrderQty,0)+ISNULL(c.OutQty,0) AS OrderQty,

CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),NULL) AS LastQty,

CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),NULL) AS CombineQty,

CONVERT(INT,NULL) AS IsMasterOrder,

c.Remarks,

b.SheetNo AS JobSheetNo,

b.NewProdID,

c.LabelID AS LabelID,

b.PreRolls,

b.PreVatQty,

c.ColorID,

c.CustColorNum,

b.SheetDate,

ISNULL(b.PreRolls,0)Rolls,

ISNULL(b.PreVatQty,0)WeightQty,

c.CustJobNo,

b.Q12,

b.Q13,

b.PreField1,

b.FixedQty

FROM dye.JobSheet b 

LEFT JOIN dye.vwOrderToJob c ON c.CheckNo = b.CheckNo

WHERE 1=1

AND JobSheetType IN ('1','2')

AND ISNULL(b.CheckNo,'')<>''
